We may need "autofocus: true/false/auto" Because otherwise people setting "true" would think that there will be always autofocus. While auto would be the "smart" one from the description that should fit most use cases?

autofocus: true => always autofocus (query or no query set)
autofocus: false => always disabled
autofocus: auto => (default) smart autofocus
